x-e-h3-06.title: Vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro vane zvibodzwa zvakakwira: chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva?

x-e-h3-06.material:

x-e-h3-06.thinking.1: Kutaura kuti ruzivo rwuri rwupi rwunobatsira
x-e-h3-06.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwokunyora mutsara wokurudzira wakareruka muChirungu (Give ... to ..., then compare ...)
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rwupi rwunodikanwa kutonga mhedziso yokuti 'chisvusvuro chemahara chechikoro chinokwidza zvibodzwa'? Sarudza zvose zvinokodzera.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana ruzivo rwega rwega ruchibatsira kupindura mubvunzo, 'Hukama pakati pechisvusvuro nezvibodzwa ichikonzero here?'
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.hint.1: Funga chikonzero chimwe chinoita kuti mhedziso ive yakanganisa, uye utsvage ruzivo rwaizvitarisa.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.a: Ikukosha kwaunogona kutoverenga kubva pamavhareji emapoka maviri, uye hakuudzi chikonzero chomusiyano wezvibodzwa.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.b: Uyu mubvunzo unotarisa kana pane zvimwe zvakasiyana, kunze kwokudya chisvusvuro, zvingakanganisa zvibodzwa.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.c: Uyu mubvunzo unotsvaga mamiriro akaedza chikonzero zvakananga.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.d: Mutengo unodikanwa pakutonga kana uchizviita, asi hauzi humbowo hwokuti zvinokwidza zvibodzwa.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.r.e: Kuenzanisa zvibodzwa, zvinofanira kunge zvakayerwa nenheyo imwe chete.
x-e-h3-06.s.s1.explain: b inotarisa zvimwe zvikonzero (kurara, nguva yokudzidza), c inotarisa mhedzisiro yokupindira kwechokwadi, uye e inotarisa kururama kwokuenzanisa. a ne d hazvisi humbowo hwokuti zvokudya zvinokwidza zvibodzwa.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.prompt: Mhedziso ipi inokodzera zvikuru yaunogona kutaura kubva patafura oga?
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.hint.0: Paradzanisa zvinotaura nhamba dziri patafura nokududzira chikonzero.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kana mutsara wemhedziso une 'because' kana 'if ... then,' tarisa kana tafura ichiratidzawo izvozvo.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.a: Avhareji yezvibodzwa zvevadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro yaiva yakakwirira kupfuura yevasingadyi
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.a: Kutonga uku kunotaura zvokwadi zvinoratidzwa netafura chete uye kunosiya chikonzero chiri pachena.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.b: Kana chisvusvuro chemahara chikatangwa, avhareji yezvibodzwa zvechikoro ichakwira
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.b: Tafura inoenzanisa vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro nevasingadyi chete, uye hairatidzi mhedzisiro yokupa chisvusvuro.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.c: Kutaura kuti hapana hukama kana tafura ichiratidza musiyano hakuenderani netafura.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.o.d: Vadzidzi vanodya chisvusvuro vachiwanda muchikoro, avhareji yacho yezvibodzwa inokwira
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.r.d: Tafura haina data rezvikoro. Iyi mhedzisiro yokuenzanisa mapoka maviri chete muchikoro chimwe ichi.
x-e-h3-06.s.s2.explain: Tafura inoratidza musiyano weavhareji pakati pemapoka maviri chete uye hairatidzi chikonzero. Kuti utaure nezvechikonzero, unoda ruzivo rwakawedzerwa runodzivirira dzimwe tsananguro.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.prompt: Ungaenzanisa sei kuti utarise kana chisvusvuro chemahara chichikwidza zvibodzwa? Kurudzira mumitsara mumwe kana miviri yeChirungu. Unofanira kudzivisa kushaya simba kwokuenzanisa kuri patafura (vadzidzi vanodya nevasingadyi vangasiyana nenzira dzimwe kunze kwokudya).
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.hint.0: Funga nzira imwe iyo mapoka maviri okuenzanisa patafura aigona kunge akasiyana kunze kwechokudya chisvusvuro.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti ungasarudza sei kuti ndiani anowana chokudya kuti musiyano uyu usavepo.
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, To test this, we could ...
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Munzira yako, vadzidzi vanowana chokudya nevasingawani (kana pamberi napashure pechokudya) vakafanana zvakakwana kuti vaenzaniswe here?
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Zvakajeka here kuti uri kuenzanisa zvibodzwa zvemapoka api kana nguva dzipi?
x-e-h3-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yakashandisa pamberi napashure pechokudya pamwe chete nemamiriro ezvimwe zvikoro.

x-e-h3-03.title: Chiitiko chimwechete, misoro yenhau yakasiyana: kutonga kunochinja sezvo ruzivo rwunokura
x-e-h3-03.goal: Sezvo ruzivo rwunokura, ongorora zvakare kuti mutsindo womusoro wenhau nezvakasiiwa zvinotsvedza sei kudivi rimwe kana zvichienzaniswa nezvokwadi, uye utsanangure chinhu chimwe muChirungu.
x-e-h3-03.material: Nyaya inoratidza kuti khonsoro yedhorobha yakasarudza kukwidziridza mari yekupaka padyo nechiteshi inotsunga yakaburitswa nhanho nhanho. Tarisa kana kutonga kwako kuchichinja nguva dzose ruzivo ruchikura.
x-e-h3-03.thinking.0: Kunzwisisa kutaridzika kunoitwa nesarudzo yemashoko nezvakasiiwa
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.prompt: Musoro wenyaya nezvirimo zvinoratidzwa chimwe chimwe. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru uchishandisa ruzivo rwuripo kusvika zvino.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Siyanisa mashoko ari musoro anopa zvokwadi neanopa manzwiro.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wenzanisa kana ruzivo rutsva ruchichinja kutonga kwako kwekare.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Headline: "Council Slaps Drivers with 50 Percent Fee Hike Near Station" (slap: kurova nechanza chakatsetseka, hike: kuwedzera kukuru kwemutengo)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Musoro uyu unopa muverengi kutaridzika kwakadini?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Shoko rekutonga senge 'slaps' rakaiswa pamusoro pechokwadi (mari inokwira). Panguva ino wangonzwisisa kutaridzika chete.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Inonzwika semusoro unongozivisa zvokwadi pasina kutaridzika kwakawedzerwa, nekuti une nhamba (50 Percent)
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kunyange nhamba ichiri yakarurama, shoko rakadai se "slaps" rinogadzira kutaridzika.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Inonzwika yakapfava, seyekuti khonsoro yakakwidziridza mari nekungwarira
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: "Slaps" haisi shoko rekungwarira kana rakapfava; rinoreva kurova munhu zvisina kunaka.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Inonzwika sekuti vatyairi vari kurangwa zvisina kururama
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: "Slaps" ne "hike" zvinogadzira kutaridzika kunoita kuti vatyairi vaonekwe sevakakuvadzwa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ndima yekutanga yenyaya: Mari yeawa yekupaka inobva ku 1,000 won ichienda ku 1,500 won, kukwidziridza kwekutanga mu 12 years. Vhoti yekhonsoro yaiva 5 ku 4.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kuongorora kwakakodzera zvikuru kwe 'a 50 percent fee hike' ne 'slaps' mumusoro kwakadini?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Nhamba yakarurama. Asi shoko 'slaps' nekusiiwa kwemamiriro ekuti mari yakanga isina kukwira kwemakore 12 zvakatsvedzera kutaridzika kudivi rimwe.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sezvo nhamba yakarurama, musoro uyu musoro usingasarudzi divi unoziviswa zvokwadi chete.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange nhamba ichiri yakarurama, kutaridzika kunogona kuchinja zvichienderana nesarudzo yemashoko nezvakasiiwa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Nhamba yakarurama, asi shoko "slaps" nekusiiwa kwe "first in 12 years" zvinogadzira kutaridzika kuri kudivi rimwe.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakaitwa nekutarisa zvokwadi nekuongorora mutsindo nezvakasiiwa zvakaparadzana.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nhamba pachayo haina kururama, saka musoro unhema uye hapana chikonzero chekutaura nezvekusarudza divi.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kukwira kubva ku 1,000 kuenda ku 1,500 chaizvo ndi 50 percent. Izvi ndizvo zvinoitika kana ukataura kuti chimwe chinhu chinhema pasina kutarisa nhamba.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Gare gare munyaya: Mari yakawedzerwa ichashandiswa panzira mbiri itsva dzemabhazi. Guta rakavakidzana rinoda 2,000 won paawa. Nhengo dzekhonsoro 4 dzakavhotera kuramba dzakati kukwidziridza kwakanyanya.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Tichipa zvokwadi zvinozikanwa kusvika zvino, musoro mutsva upi unoenzana zvikuru?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Musoro unoenzana unoshandisa zvokwadi zvakasimbiswa chete uye unosiya mashoko ekutonga. Misoro yakawanda yakadaro inogoneka, uye kutaridzika kunosiyana zvishoma zvichienderana nezvokwadi zvawasarudza. Muviri unotarisira mamwe mamiriro.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Shoko rekutonga "wisely" rinogadzira kutaridzika kunofadza, uye maonero anopesana akasiiwa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Une zvokwadi zvakasimbiswa chete (vhoti, mari) uye unosiya mashoko ekutonga.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 'Furious' inogadzira ndokunamatira manzwiro asina kusimbiswa munyaya.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Inoshandisa zvokwadi zvakasimbiswa chete uye haina shoko rekutonga. Mhedzisiro yevhoti nemaonero anopesana zvakasiiwa, asi isarudzo inogamuchirwa pamusoro wenhau.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Reader comment: "Every headline leaves something out, so there is no such thing as a fair headline."
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.ask: Mhinduro ipi yakakodzera zvikuru kukomendi iyi?
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Kusiya hakudzivisike. Saka panzvimbo pe 'une divi kana kwete,' zvinobatsira zvikuru kuenzanisa 'sarudzo ipi inotsvedzera zvakanyanya.'
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Zvakadaro zvishoma. Kusiya hakugoni kudzivirirwa, asi dzimwe sarudzo dzinotsvedzera zvakanyanya kudivi rimwe.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Uku kutonga kunoziva zvose kuti kusiya hakudzivisike uye kuti pane misiyano yedanho.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Zvechokwadi. Naizvozvo misoro yose ine divi rimwechete zvakaenzana.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: "Zvose zvinosiya, saka zvose zvakafanana" mhedziso inosiya kuenzanisa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Zvenhema. Kana ukanyora zvokwadi chete senge nhamba namazuva, musoro hausiyi chinhu.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Kusarudza kuti zvokwadi zvipi zvinosanganisirwa pachezvo isarudzo, saka kusiya kunoitika.
x-e-h3-03.s.s1.reflect: Pawakaona musoro wekutanga chete, waigona kunzwisisa kutaridzika chete, uye mushure mekutarisa zvokwadi waigona kuongorora nhamba nemutsindo zvakaparadzana. Kana ruzivo rutsva ruchiuya, unoongorora zvakare kutonga 'musoro uyu une divi' uchiukamura kuita nhamba, mashoko nezvakasiiwa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza shoko rimwe kana chakasiiwa chimwe chinoita kuti musoro wekutanga (Council Slaps Drivers ...) uonekwe uchitsvedzera kudivi rimwe, uchitsanangure muChirungu.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza shoko rimwe mumusoro rinopa manzwiro.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kuti kutaridzika kwemuverengi kwaizochinja sei dai shoko iroro rabviswa.
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura here kuti shoko kana chakasiiwa chawakasarudza chinochinja 'kutaridzika,' kwete zvokwadi?
x-e-h3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Kana wakasarudza chakasiiwa, wakanyora chaizvo here kuti chii chakasiiwa?

x-e-h3-08.title: Imeyili yokukumbira mudzidzisi kuwedzera nguva yokupedzisira
x-e-h3-08.goal: Tsvaga kuti mashoko api mudhirafti anonzwika sodaidzo, uanyore patsva semeyili ine ruremekedzo inokumbira mudzidzisi, uye ufungidzire zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemhinduro.
x-e-h3-08.material: Nguva yokupedzisira yeessay i Chishanu, asi unoda kuipa mazuva maviri shure nokuda kwokudzidzira mutambo wechikoro. Iri idhirafti rakanyorwa nomudzidzi kuti atumire kumudzidzisi weChirungu, Mr. Lee.
x-e-h3-08.thinking.2: Kufungidzira zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvemashoko asina kunanga
x-e-h3-08.prereq.0: Mashoko akakosha eimeyili senge Dear ~, ne Thank you
x-e-h3-08.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwokuona zvikumbiro zvakaitwa ne could ne would
x-e-h3-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe unogona kunzwika sa "daidzo, kwete chikumbiro" kana mudzidzisi achiuverenga. (Kunyange kana pane mitsetse miviri kana kupfuura yakadaro, unongoda kusarudza mumwe wayo.)
x-e-h3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsetse wega wega uye utarise kana unonzwika kunounzwa saidzo ('ita izvi') panzvimbo pechikumbiro ('ndapota ita').

x-e-h3-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 (Give me ...) nomutsetse 4 (Reply today.) uri muchimiro chokuraira, sokunge uri kuraira mudzidzisi. Hey yomutsetse 1 neBye yomutsetse 5 zvakaita sezvaunotaura neshamwari, izvo zvinosuruvarisa, asi chinangwa chomubvunzo uyu kutsvaga mitsetse inonzwika sokuraira.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva dhirafti muChirungu semeyili ine ruremekedzo kumudzidzisi. Sanganisira kukwazisa, chikumbiro chinyoro, chikonzero, nokutenda.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga nzira dzokushandura mitsara yakadhirafti inonzwika sokuraira kuva mibvunzo kana zvirevo zvemamiriro.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kurongeka kweimeyili (kukwazisa - chikumbiro - chikonzero - kutenda) uye unyore chikamu chimwe panguva imwe.
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandura mutsara wechikumbiro kuva mubvunzo kana chirevo chokufungidzira panzvimbo pe 'Give me' here?
x-e-h3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti chikonzero chinoverengwa setsananguro yemamiriro kwete chikonzero chokuramba?
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.prompt: Mr. Lee akapindura seizvi. "Fine, but I hope this won't become a habit." Chii chinonzwisisika zvikuru kufungidzira kubva mumhinduro iyi?
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga chikamu chokutanga nechokupedzisira chemhinduro zvakasiyana uye uone kuti chimwe nechimwe chinoti chii.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti mutsara unotanga ne 'hope' unosiyana sei nomutemo wakananga.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.r.a: Wakaverenga 'Fine' (mvumo) ne 'hope ... won't become a habit' (chido chokuti zvisadzokororwa) pamwe chete.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.r.b: Pangava papo pawakakanganwa izwi rokuti 'Fine' uye wakaverenga yambiro inotevera chete.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.r.c: Hapana kutaura kwakananga kwokugumbuka. Uku kufungidzira kunoverenga manzwiro akawandisa.
x-e-h3-08.s.s3.explain: Mhinduro inogamuchira chikumbiro ichitakura zvinoreva zvakavanzika zvokusadzokorora. Kutaura kwakadaro hakutauri zvakananga kuti 'kwete muneramangwana' asi kunotaura nokunyorova zvinotarisirwa.

x-e-h3-02.goal: Musaga womumiriri wekirasi yevadzidzi, siyanisa ruzivo rwunogona kutariswa nekukumbira kunobata manzwiro, uye uongorore kana inopindura maonero anopesana.
x-e-h3-02.material:
Iyi ndiyo chikamu chesaga yaMina, mumiriri wedzidzo anovimbisa kuvaka library itsva.
"Our school library has 6,000 books, but 40 percent of them are more than fifteen years old. Last year, 300 students borrowed more than ten books each. Some say we cannot afford a new library. But can we afford to let our dreams gather dust? Vote for a new library, and vote for our future."

x-e-h3-10.thinking.2: Kutonga kuti dambudziko rakakura sei zvichienderana nemamiriro
x-e-h3-10.prereq.0: Maitiro anoshandiswa nema pronouns eChirungu (she, her)
x-e-h3-10.prereq.1: Mitsara yekutaura zvisina kunanga (She told me that ...)
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe unogona kunzwisiswa zvakasiyana nevaverengi vakasiyana.
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.hint.0: Mumutsetse wega wega, tarisa kana unogona kugadza 'ani anoita chii' kuita chimwe chete.
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.hint.1: Mumitsetse ine ma pronouns, verenga kuti munhu wega wega angatorwa nema pronoun anoitirwa nevanhu vangani.
x-e-h3-10.s.s1.explain: 'She' yemumutsetse 2 inogona kureva Ms. Han kana Ms. Seo. Saka ani anofanira kubhuka holo inogona kuverengwa nenzira mbiri. Mimwe mitsetse inogona kuverengwa nenzira imwe chete nezve ani anofanira kuita chii.
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.prompt: Nyora muChirungu zvinoreva zviviri zvingaitwa nemutsetse 2, imwe neimwe semutsara unogona kuverengwa nenzira imwe chete. (Nyora mitsara miviri.)
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvakasiyana chiitiko apo 'she' i Ms. Han nechiitiko apo 'she' i Ms. Seo.
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kana ukashandisa quotation marks sekunge uri kududzira zvakananga panzvimbo ye pronoun, zvinova pachena kuti ani ari kutaura.
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Ms. Han told Ms. Seo, "..."
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Munhu anoverenga mutsara wega wega wemitsara yako miviri anogona kuunzwisisa nenzira imwe chete here?
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mutsara wakaramba wakajairika usina kushandisa pronoun here?
x-e-h3-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Panzvimbo pekududzira zvakananga, zvakaita kuti zvive pachena nekudzokorora zita nekushandisa reflexive pronoun.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.prompt: Mune chiitiko chipi kutumira mutsara wekutanga (Ms. Han told Ms. Seo that she had to book the hall.) sezvawakaita kwaizova dambudziko guru here?
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.hint.0: Funga kana vaverengi vachigona kuziva kubva kune imwe nzvimbo kunze kwemeseji iyi kuti ani ari kubhuka.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.hint.1: Mamiriro api anofanira kugutswa nevaverengi kuti kusajeka kuite kukuvadza?
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.o.a: Kana uchitumira kuboka rechati rinoverengwa nevanhu vakawanda nekukurumidza
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.r.a: Vaverengi vakawanda uye vachiverenga nekukurumidza, kuverenga zvisirizvo kunova nemukana wakawanda.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.o.b: Kana chiratidzo chekushamisika chakabatanidzwa pakupera kwemutsara
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.r.b: Zviratidzo zvekunyora hazvigone kuchinja kuti pronoun inoreva ani.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.o.c: Kana munhu wese achitoziva kuti ani ari kubhuka
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.r.c: Ichi i chiitiko apo ruzivo rwunobva pamamiriro runogadzirisa kusajeka.
x-e-h3-10.s.s3.explain: Kusajeka i dambudziko remashoko pachawo, asi kana vaverengi vatoziva ruzivo, kukuvadza kudiki. Kuvaverengi vakawanda vasina ruzivo, kunofanira kugadziriswa.
